label: Hidden Placket
description: The Hidden placket — also called the Covered or Fly-front placket — conceals the buttons behind an extra flap of shirt fabric that folds over the button line, so the front of the shirt presents an unbroken, smooth expanse of cloth. This is the most formal and elegant placket choice, favoured for dress shirts and tuxedo shirts where a clean, uninterrupted line from collar to waist is desirable. It imparts a refined, almost sculptural look to the shirt front.
